verdict.rationale: Vue's own documentation includes an Examples section and a Tutorial, and the site claims 'world-class documentation' covering its API, which points toward an official example-driven reference. However, nothing in the evidence says these examples are runnable or interactive, or that they are tied to an API reference. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an API reference page, evidence that examples are runnable/interactive in-browser (e.g. playground), independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
